chunks: Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who performed the Tawaf of hajj and the Tawaf al-Nisāʾ before he performed saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah. He said: “It does not harm him; he performs the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah, and he has completed his hajj.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two known points of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other point of saʿy
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf associated with the permissibility of marital relations after hajj rites
key_terms.لَا يَضُرُّهُ: it does not harm him; it does not invalidate the act
key_terms.يَسْعَى: he performs the saʿy, walking between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone performs Tawaf al-Hajj and Tawaf al-Nisa before saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the order of rites in hajj. It states that if a person performs Tawaf al-Hajj and Tawaf al-Nisa before the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah, this does not invalidate his pilgrimage, and he should simply perform the saʿy afterward.
